7496.title: Responsive context layout commits after resize delivery
7496.rootCauseOneLine: Resize delivery schedules React layout state without committing card and transcript DOM before callback return; native paint timing was not verified.

prReviews.topFinding: Targets the measured deferred commit; native frame timing remains untested and test stub cleanup is not unconditional.

7496.proposedFix: Commit changed resize bands synchronously, preserve initial layout-effect measurement, and verify native frame timing. Existing open PR #7497 already covers the issue.
7496.caveats: Controlled ResizeObserver delivery under React act, not a native paint test. Chrome unavailable; no live screenshot, desktop test, or right-panel animation matrix. The diagnostic SVG is a visualization of measured DOM values, not a screenshot.
